name: @runope/pi-coding-agent
description: Coding agent CLI with read, bash, edit, write tools and session management

scripts.build: bun build ./src/cli.ts --outdir ./dist --target node && bun shx chmod +x dist/cli.js && bun run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: bun run build && bun build --compile ./dist/cli.js --outfile dist/pi
scripts.copy-assets: bun shx mkdir -p dist/modes/interactive/theme && bun shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/modes/interactive/theme/ && bun shx mkdir -p dist/modes/interactive/assets && bun shx cp src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png dist/modes/interactive/assets/ && bun shx mkdir -p dist/core/export-html/vendor && bun shx cp src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/core/export-html/ && bun shx cp src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/core/export-html/vendor/
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build

author: Mario Zechner
